title: Dashboard: support health
question: How should the support dashboard arrange its panels?

options.label: KPI row, then charts
options.description: Four headline numbers across the top, charts in a grid below.

options.label: One hero chart
options.description: A large trend chart with the numbers in a column beside it.

options.label: Even grid
options.description: Six equal panels with no hierarchy. Simple, but nothing says what matters most.

content: The dashboard stays open on a wall display and on laptops. It tracks open tickets, first response time, backlog age and satisfaction.
